title: Render hardware encoder runtime proof gaps in WebView
summary: Rendered backend-provided hardware encoder runtime proof gaps in the WebView Settings encoder capability summary and Launch backend preflight summary.
reason: The backend now threads hardware runtime verified/skipped and active-hardware-unverified encoder lists into descriptor capability reports; the operator surface needed to expose that evidence without enabling dormant hardware families or changing FFmpeg policy.
behavior_before: Settings and Launch could show descriptor activation evidence, but hardware runtime verified/skipped and active-hardware-unverified proof gaps were only present in backend detail and not summarized for operator review.
behavior_after: Settings renders a read-only hardware runtime proof line plus review-only skipped/unverified guidance from encoder_capability_report. Launch preflight aggregates the same backend detail across active preflight payloads and displays hardware runtime proof gaps without enabling hardware encoders or changing start authority.
tests_added: tests.webview.test_webview_handbrake_settings_ui.WebViewHandBrakeSettingsUiTests.test_encoder_capability_report_is_read_only_settings_evidence now requires Settings hardware runtime proof-gap rendering tokens.

tests.webview.test_webview_launch_command_buttons_smoke.WebViewLaunchCommandButtonsSmoke.test_backend_preflight_refresh_is_explicit_and_splits_csv_preview_from_start now asserts Launch hardware runtime verified/skipped/unverified proof-gap summary text.
rollback_plan: Revert the Settings/Launch WebView rendering changes, the focused WebView test expectations, the docs wording updates, and regenerated summaries. This is read-only UI evidence only; no media files, backend mutation routes, FFmpeg policy, or source/scratch/output state are changed.
